items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: this is due to gzip including timestamp info in compressed payloads, which makes two gzip streams differ even if they decode to the exact same bytes
items.rationale: Identifies the root cause (gzip header mtime) that the reference helper works around by ignoring bytes 4:8. It doesn't name the changed file or give the helper, and its suggestion of round-trip tests differs from the reference.
items.author: d-v-b

items.label: symptom
items.evidence: I'll find the test that compares exact gzip bytes and change it to compare decoded output instead.
items.rationale: Proposes comparing decoded output. The reference instead adds a helper that compares the gzip streams while ignoring the mtime header bytes. The comment gives no location or mechanism beyond the issue.
